verses.2: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
verses.3: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?
verses.4: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
verses.5: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.
verses.6: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek
verses.7: But go your way, tell his disciples and
verses.8: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.
verses.10: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
verses.11: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
verses.12: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
verses.13: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
verses.14: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.
verses.19: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.
verses.20: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
